title: Sackcloth and Ashes
summary: Sackcloth and ashes were visible signs of mourning, humility, distress, repentance, or urgent appeal to God.
background: Because the actions were outward and public, prophets could use them to display seriousness before God and before the community.
teachingHelp: Teach sackcloth and ashes as embodied humility or grief, not as a mechanical ritual that guarantees repentance.
